task: Families stopped washing dirty clothes by hand on metal washboards. A child never says the whole phrase back: "electric machines", "invented", "put", "homes" count on their own or in a sentence, and so does its place in the menu. expectedAnswer: The three events, in order: 1) Leo holds a big kite in the park. 2) The kite flies up past a tall tree. 3) A little bird watches the kite fly high.
